The investigation was efficient (38 tool calls, ~3 minutes) and methodical. The main gap is not identifying the CAS read-only hard link mechanism as the specific cause of 'Access is denied' — instead attributing it to file locking during concurrent signing. The proposed fix is practical and would resolve the issue regardless of the underlying mechanism. Overall a strong investigation with one significant analytical gap.
